name: Everything Changes
source:
Being in therapy for years can be draining, plus being in college and working adds on top of the stress. Your therapist invited you to a therapy camp that they are hosting. It also turned out that your best friend is also going! Will you try to make new friends or stay with the ones you have? Will those friendships grow into something more, or will you be ditched? Will this camp cause you to ask for more help and find friends to help you, or fall deeper into the hands of depression?

Everything Changes takes place in modern times, following a depressed college raccoon student as they traverses the stresses of life. After their therapist recommends them to go to a therapy camp the therapist is hosting. Along with them, their best friend also decided to join.

[From [url=https://krno.itch.io/everything-changes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
接受多年的治疗可能会让人筋疲力尽，加上上大学和工作又增加了压力。你的治疗师邀请你参加他们举办的治疗营。原来你最好的朋友也要去！你会尝试结交新朋友还是和现有的朋友待在一起？这些友谊会发展得更多，还是会被抛弃？这个营地会让你寻求更多的帮助，寻找朋友来帮助你，还是让你陷入更深的抑郁之中？

《一切都变了》发生在现代，讲述了一名抑郁的浣熊大学学生穿越生活压力的故事。在治疗师建议他们去治疗师主办的治疗营后。他们最好的朋友也决定加入。
